_meta.description: Skeleton J1587 database for CSU-RP1210. It defines the schema and contains NO SAE J1587 content.
replace_with_licensed_copy: Create J1587db.licensed.json (metric) and J1587db.us.licensed.json (US customary) from your licensed SAE J1587 document with Tools > J1587 Database, or: python j1587db_tools.py generate J1587.pdf
The generated files are git-ignored. Do not commit or share licensed content.

schema.PID: {pid: {Name, DataLength (characters or 'Variable'), DataType, BitResolution, Offset, Unit, Minimum, Maximum, FormatStr, DataForm, Period, Priority}}. Page 2 PIDs are 256-511. value = raw * BitResolution + Offset; raw is little-endian and, for PIDs 192-253, follows a byte count.
schema.PIDNames: {pid: name} for diagnostic codes that refer to a PID
schema.SID: {mid: {sid: name}}, with '-1' holding the SIDs common to all MIDs (also copied into each MID)
